poses.caption: Lie flat and support one raised thigh with both hands. Gently straighten that knee while keeping your head, pelvis and other leg relaxed on the mat. Hold 20–30 seconds and switch legs.

jobs.prompt: Use case scientific-educational. Original premium ADULT male detailed anatomical illustration canonical1576 LEG UP HAMSTRING STRETCH. ONE STATIC HOLD exactly ONE full body person lying SUPINE on thin gray mat side three-quarter view head LEFT feet RIGHT. Back of SKULL shoulders pelvis relaxed RESTING DIRECTLY on mat; short cropped PIXIE hair makes skull contact clearly visible, head NEVER raised neck relaxed face upward. LEFT nonworking leg fully extended FLAT along mat toward RIGHT left heel grounded. RIGHT working leg raised upward about75degrees, knee nearly straight with slight softness, working ankle neutral foot well ABOVE hips. BOTH hands gently hold BEHIND RIGHT mid-thigh above knee below buttock, fingers wrap thigh sides, elbows bent no neck pull. Pelvis grounded back relaxed no twist. Primary RIGHT raised posterior thigh HAMSTRINGS RED: exposed distal posterior thigh fine detailed red anatomy, upper covered hamstring only diffuse RED tint on INTACT BLACK shorts BACK thigh. NO anatomical fibers through cloth, no shorts cutaway. All other muscles grayscale including free calf/quad/glutes. Fine detailed grayscale exposed anatomy realistic limbs hands fingers proportions. Full opaque BLACK tank wraps FRONT SIDES BACK, black MID-THIGH shorts cover FRONT SIDES BACK SEAT CROTCH including raised leg continuous hems seams broad real folds no transparency/cutaway. Black shoes. Pure WHITE background soft contact shadows generous12percent margins full skull hands both feet mat inside SQUARE no crop. Equal male/female quality. Original project reference rendering STYLE ONLY ignore pushup/chest red. No labels text captions arrows extra panels.
